purpose.zh: 用椅子支撑上背，强化臀部
purpose.en: Strengthen your glutes with your upper back on a chair.

text.zh: 脚跟推地把髋顶起，顶端夹紧臀部
text.en: Drive through your heels to lift your hips and squeeze your glutes at the top

text.zh: 上背靠在稳固椅面边缘，双脚与髋同宽
text.en: Rest your upper back on the edge of a sturdy chair, feet hip-width apart.

text.zh: 顶端大腿和躯干成一线，小腿竖直
text.en: At the top, keep thighs and trunk level with shins vertical.

commonErrors.zh: 腰部过度拱起代替臀部发力
commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.

cautions.zh: 确认椅子稳固不滑；腰部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Make sure the chair will not slide; reduce the range if your lower back hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
